CIV.note: Internet access pricing response; nothing on a business register.

facts.fact: Orange Cote d'Ivoire, answering the regulator's November 2024 consultation, discusses pricing of its colocation rooms and rack-slot rental to third-party operators, saying volume-based pricing is not adequate and quality factors such as access security and backup power should count.

CIV.note: Document does not say the consultation ran online.

facts.fact: Orange Cote d'Ivoire says the authorisation of two new submarine cables brought to five the number of submarine cables landing in Cote d'Ivoire.
facts.system: Submarine cables landing in Cote d'Ivoire

facts.fact: Orange Cote d'Ivoire lists open access at the submarine cable landing point among the regulator's actions, with wholesale prices for international capacity capped since 2016 and 2020, and says infrastructure competition on submarine cables is real with no barriers.
facts.system: Submarine cable landing point open access

CIV.note: Ownership of the colocation facility's site and Tier not stated; Orange CI is a subsidiary of a foreign group.

facts.fact: The regulator ARTCI launched a public consultation in November 2024 to collect stakeholders' views on a study of internet access pricing, and Orange Cote d'Ivoire sent its response on 4 December 2024.
facts.system: ARTCI public consultation on internet access pricing
